svg.title: Hybrid multi-Region landing zone on AWS
svg.desc: Hybrid multi-Region landing zone on AWS. 24 components in 19 groups. Connections: Employees to Corporate identity provider (sign in); Corporate identity provider to AWS IAM Identity Center (SAML 2.0 and SCIM); Customer router to AWS Direct Connect (BGP); AWS Direct Connect to Direct Connect gateway (transit VIF); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway (association); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway (association); Customer router to AWS Site-to-Site VPN (IPsec); AWS Site-to-Site VPN to AWS Transit Gateway (VPN attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Transit Gateway; AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Network Firewall (inspection); AWS Transit Gateway to Amazon Route 53 VPC Resolver; AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Network Firewall (inspection); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.1.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.2.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.9.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); Corporate DNS to Amazon Route 53 VPC Resolver (conditional forwarding); AWS Control Tower to AWS Organizations (applies controls); AWS Organizations to Security OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Infrastructure OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Workloads OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Security Tooling account (delegated administrator); AWS CloudTrail to Amazon Simple Storage Service (all accounts); AWS Config to Amazon Simple Storage Service (configuration snapshots); AWS CloudTrail to AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS); and more.

text.tspan: HYBRID MULTI-REGION LANDING ZONE ON AWS
Security, Infrastructure and Workloads OUs in AWS Organizations; Direct Connect with VPN backup into two Regions; central inspection, logging and threat detection
IDENTITY, POLICY, DNS, LOGS AND FINDINGS
